title: Agentic Routing: Harness-Native Data Flywheel — Wiki Page (arXiv:2607.11399)
description: New wiki page covering step-level model routing inside agent harnesses. Key insight: routing decisions produce labeled training records automatically (harness-native data flywheel), enabling self-improving routing without human annotation. Relevant to H318 meta-learner selector, multi-agent trading architectures, and dream cycle design. OpenSquilla implementation available open-source with LightGBM cold-start ranker.

source.title: Agentic Routing: The Harness-Native Data Flywheel
source.authors: Xinchen Liu, Hang Zhou, Yingjie Zong et al. (Huawei Noah's Ark Lab)
